newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Danone to maintain 1996 profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Danone to maintain 1996 profit forecast.

text.p: French food company Danone SA said on Tuesday it would be able to achieve its projected six percent growth in net profit for 1996 despite the poor weather that hit Europe in the third quarter.
"I am really confident the six percent year on year growth in net profit will be achieved," said Franck Riboud, chairman and chief executive officer of Danone SA.
He said although the seasonal bad weather had affected the beer and mineral water business, these would be offset by better performances in other areas like biscuits and dairy products.
In October, Danone reported nine-month sales of 63.2 billion French francs compared with 60.2 billion French francs previously.
